remaining.title: vCard/MeCard, SMS and geo code types
remaining.why: From the research's mostWantedNext rather than the review's fix list, and not a defect. Adding three payload builders plus their field panels, print-card copy and batch handling is a feature-sized piece of work that would have come out of the verification budget for the eleven blockers and majors above. The type selector, print sheet and batch path are all now table-driven, so each new type is a TYPES row and a renderFields branch.
